description: HyprMX ad SDK — placement-based interstitial and rewarded ads

methods.name: initialize
methods.note: Primary disable lever. HyprMX is a Kotlin object (INSTANCE); initialize has void overloads taking a HyprMXInitializationListener or Function1<InitResult>, plus a suspend (Continuation) overload that returns Object -> return-null. The init callback (onHyprMXInitializationComplete/Failed) will NOT fire once stubbed. HANG RISK if the app gates its UI on the init callback; note and verify against the target app.

methods.name: loadAd
methods.note: Concrete Placement implementation in 5.x (readable). loadAd is listener-driven (HyprMXLoadAdListener/Function1<Boolean>); the suspend overload returns Object -> return-null. NOTE: 6.x obfuscates this impl to a single-letter class (e.g. com.hyprmx.android.sdk.placement.p), so on 6.x this target will not match — rely on the HyprMX.initialize entry point there.

manifest_components.note: Video player activity (present in 5.x; harmless if absent in the target).

protected_patterns.reason: getPlacement(String)/getPlacements() return the @NonNull Placement object(s) the app then calls loadAd/showAd on; returning null would NPE at the first dereference. Ad traffic is cut by stubbing initialize (and loadAd/showAd), not by nulling these getters.
Returns the HyprMXState enum the app checks; leave it working (it naturally reports NOT_INITIALIZED) — nulling an enum getter would NPE.
Placement.getName() returns the placement id string the app may log/route on; leave intact.
